group1.todayIdea: When you know a part and its percent, you can work backward to find the whole, which is 100%.
group1.todayIdeaEs: Cuando conoces una parte y su porcentaje, puedes trabajar hacia atrás para hallar el entero, que es el 100%.

examples.title: Example 1 · Use a double number line
examples.titleEs: Ejemplo 1 · Usa una recta numérica doble
examples.problem: Akela paid $42 for a sweater on sale. That was 60% of the original price. What was the original price?
examples.problemEs: Akela pagó $42 por un suéter en oferta. Eso era el 60% del precio original. ¿Cuál era el precio original?

figure.caption: $42 lines up with 60%. $70 lines up with 100%.
figure.captionEs: $42 se alinea con el 60%. $70 se alinea con el 100%.

steps.do: Match the part with its percent.
steps.doEs: Empareja la parte con su porcentaje.
steps.why: The original price is the whole. The whole is 100%.
steps.whyEs: El precio original es el entero. El entero es el 100%.

examples.title: Example 2 · Use an equation
examples.problem: Solve the same problem with an equation. $42 is 60% of the original price. Let v be the original price.
examples.problemEs: Resuelve el mismo problema con una ecuación. $42 es el 60% del precio original. Sea v el precio original.

steps.do: Write the percent as a decimal.
Write an equation: percent × whole = part.
steps.doEs: Escribe una ecuación: porcentaje × entero = parte.
steps.why: The whole is unknown, so the letter v stands for it.
steps.whyEs: El entero es desconocido, así que la letra v lo representa.

steps.why: The whole should be more than the part. $70 is more than $42.
steps.whyEs: El entero debe ser mayor que la parte. $70 es mayor que $42.

together.title: Let's do one together
together.problem: Sheng's car is now worth $26,600. That is 70% of what his parents paid for it. What did they pay for the car?
together.problemEs: El carro de Sheng ahora vale $26,600. Eso es el 70% de lo que pagaron sus papás por él. ¿Cuánto pagaron por el carro?

steps.ask: Which number is the part? Which is the percent?
steps.askEs: ¿Cuál número es la parte? ¿Cuál es el porcentaje?
steps.answer: The part is $26,600. The percent is 70%.
steps.answerEs: La parte es $26,600. El porcentaje es 70%.

steps.ask: Write an equation. Use v for the price they paid.
steps.askEs: Escribe una ecuación. Usa v para el precio que pagaron.

steps.ask: Divide both sides by 0.7. What is v?
steps.askEs: Divide los dos lados entre 0.7. ¿Cuánto vale v?

steps.ask: Check: is the whole more than the part?
steps.askEs: Comprueba: ¿el entero es mayor que la parte?

together.answer: Sheng's parents paid $38,000 for the car.
together.answerEs: Los papás de Sheng pagaron $38,000 por el carro.

tryIt.problem: Tom paid $24 for shoes on sale. That was 80% of the original price. What was the original price?
tryIt.problemEs: Tom pagó $24 por unos zapatos en oferta. Eso era el 80% del precio original. ¿Cuál era el precio original?
tryIt.hint: 80% is 8 groups of 10%. Find 10% first: divide 24 by 8. Then multiply by 10.
tryIt.hintEs: El 80% son 8 grupos de 10%. Primero halla el 10%: divide 24 entre 8. Luego multiplica por 10.

group1.bigIdea: To find the whole, divide the part by the percent written as a decimal, and check that the whole is more than the part.
group1.bigIdeaEs: Para hallar el entero, divide la parte entre el porcentaje escrito como decimal, y comprueba que el entero sea mayor que la parte.

group2.todayIdea: Before you divide, make sure the percent matches the part you know.
group2.todayIdeaEs: Antes de dividir, asegúrate de que el porcentaje corresponda a la parte que conoces.

examples.title: Example · The percent off is not the part
examples.titleEs: Ejemplo · El porcentaje de descuento no es la parte
examples.problem: A jacket is 25% off. Lia pays $48 for it. What was the original price?
examples.problemEs: Una chaqueta tiene 25% de descuento. Lía paga $48 por ella. ¿Cuál era el precio original?

steps.do: Find the percent that Lia pays.
steps.doEs: Halla el porcentaje que paga Lía.
steps.why: The $48 she pays is the part. It matches 75%, not 25%.
steps.whyEs: Los $48 que paga son la parte. Corresponden al 75%, no al 25%.

steps.do: Write an equation with the decimal.
steps.doEs: Escribe una ecuación con el decimal.

steps.why: Dividing by 0.25 instead gives $192. That price is much too high.
steps.whyEs: Si divides entre 0.25, obtienes $192. Ese precio es demasiado alto.

together.title: Try it together — then prove it
together.problem: Sheng's car is now worth $26,600. That is 70% of what his parents paid for it. What did they pay for the car?
together.problemEs: El carro de Sheng ahora vale $26,600. Eso es el 70% de lo que pagaron sus papás por él. ¿Cuánto pagaron por el carro?

steps.ask: Write an equation. Use v for the price they paid.
steps.askEs: Escribe una ecuación. Usa v para el precio que pagaron.

steps.ask: Why must the price they paid be more than $26,600?
steps.askEs: ¿Por qué el precio que pagaron debe ser mayor que $26,600?
steps.answer: $26,600 is only 70% of the price. The whole is 100%, so it must be bigger.
steps.answerEs: $26,600 es solo el 70% del precio. El entero es el 100%, así que debe ser mayor.

together.answer: They paid $38,000. That is more than $26,600, so the answer makes sense.
together.answerEs: Pagaron $38,000. Eso es mayor que $26,600, así que la respuesta tiene sentido.

tryIt.problem: A plant is 18 inches tall now. That is 150% of its height last month. How tall was the plant last month?
tryIt.problemEs: Una planta mide 18 pulgadas ahora. Eso es el 150% de su altura del mes pasado. ¿Cuánto medía la planta el mes pasado?
tryIt.hint: Write 150% as the decimal 1.5. Then solve 1.5 × v = 18.
tryIt.hintEs: Escribe 150% como el decimal 1.5. Luego resuelve 1.5 × v = 18.
tryIt.explain: This time the whole is smaller than the part. Why?
tryIt.explainEs: Esta vez el entero es menor que la parte. ¿Por qué?
tryIt.modelExplanation: The part is 150%, which is more than 100%. So the part is bigger than the whole. 18 ÷ 1.5 = 12, and 12 is less than 18.
tryIt.modelExplanationEs: La parte es el 150%, que es más que el 100%. Así que la parte es mayor que el entero. 18 ÷ 1.5 = 12, y 12 es menor que 18.

group2.bigIdea: Divide the part by the percent that matches it, and check the size: the whole is bigger than the part only when the percent is less than 100%.
group2.bigIdeaEs: Divide la parte entre el porcentaje que le corresponde y comprueba el tamaño: el entero es mayor que la parte solo cuando el porcentaje es menor que 100%.

catchup.title: Find the whole: divide by the percent
catchup.titleEs: Halla el entero: divide entre el porcentaje
catchup.problem: $42 is 60% of the original price. What was the original price?
catchup.problemEs: $42 es el 60% del precio original. ¿Cuál era el precio original?

steps.do: Write the percent as a decimal.
Divide the part by the decimal.
steps.doEs: Divide la parte entre el decimal.

steps.why: The whole, $70, is more than the part, $42.
steps.whyEs: El entero, $70, es mayor que la parte, $42.

examples.why: Each dollar amount lines up with its percent. $42 is 60% of $70.

examples.text: One line from 0% to 100% with no amounts
examples.why: There is only one line. No amounts line up with the percents.
It has an equal sign. Percent × whole = part.
There is no equal sign. It is an expression, not an equation.

examples.text: 9 out of 100 students walk to school → 9%
examples.why: It is already out of 100, so it is 9%.
9 out of 10 is not out of 100. It is 90 out of 100, or 90%.
